disposition: The engine keeps a typed, non-collapsed error taxonomy with durable idempotent resolution of unknown outcomes (focused-tested), cancellation is enforced at the ingest and query seams and on the wire (query.cancel, overload gate), and TBEP carries 22 typed error codes. Gap: no V1 exception-taxonomy mapping (DocumentDoesNotExist/DocumentConflict/BulkInsertAborted/AllTopologyNodesDown) on any client wire surface, and per-operation replay-safety declarations exist only as the engine-side retry_disposition, not an enumerated contract.
